import pandas as pd, warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

BOUND    = pd.Timedelta(30, unit="s")   # watermark out-of-orderness bound
LATENESS = pd.Timedelta(60, unit="s")   # allowed lateness = 1 minute
WIN      = pd.Timedelta(5,  unit="min") # tumbling window

# (event_id, user_id, event_time, amount) in ARRIVAL order.
# e11 is LATE for [00:00,00:05); e12 is TOO LATE (its window already purged).
arr = [
 ("e1","u1","00:00:00",10), ("e2","u2","00:01:00",20), ("e3","u1","00:02:00",15),
 ("e4","u3","00:03:00",30), ("e5","u2","00:04:00",25), ("e6","u1","00:05:00", 5),
 ("e7","u3","00:06:00",40),
 ("e11","u1","00:04:30", 7),            # LATE: arrives after [00:00,00:05) fired
 ("e8","u2","00:07:00",35),
 ("e12","u2","00:02:00",99),            # TOO LATE: [00:00,00:05) purged by now
 ("e9","u1","00:08:00",12), ("e10","u3","00:09:00",18),
]

def hm(ts): return str(ts)[11:19]

state, panes, wm_log = {}, [], []
max_et = None
seq = 0
def emit(ws, key, ptype, trig, wm, cum, delta, note):
    global seq; seq += 1
    panes.append(dict(seq=seq, window=f"{hm(ws)}-{hm(ws+WIN)}", key=key, pane=ptype,
                      trigger=trig, watermark=hm(wm), cum_value=cum, delta=delta, note=note))

for eid, key, tstr, amt in arr:
    et = pd.Timestamp("2024-01-01 " + tstr + "Z")
    max_et = et if (max_et is None or et > max_et) else max_et
    wm = max_et - BOUND
    wm_log.append((eid, key, hm(et), hm(wm)))
    ws = et.floor("5min"); we = ws + WIN
    st = state.setdefault((ws, key), dict(evs=[], fired=False, purged=False, val=0, emitted=0))

    # 1) route the event
    if st["purged"]:
        emit(ws, key, "DROPPED", eid, wm, st["val"], 0, "window purged -> event dropped")
    else:
        was_fired = st["fired"]
        st["evs"].append((eid, amt)); st["val"] += amt
        if was_fired:                              # already emitted ON_TIME -> late re-fire
            d = st["val"] - st["emitted"]; st["emitted"] = st["val"]
            emit(ws, key, "LATE", eid, wm, st["val"], d, "within allowed lateness (accumulating)")

    # 2) trigger check: fire when watermark passes window end
    for (w2, k2), s in state.items():
        if not s["fired"] and wm >= w2 + WIN:
            s["fired"] = True
            d = s["val"] - s["emitted"]; s["emitted"] = s["val"]
            emit(w2, k2, "ON_TIME", eid, wm, s["val"], d, "watermark >= window_end")

    # 3) teardown check: purge at window_end + lateness
    for (w2, k2), s in state.items():
        if not s["purged"] and wm >= w2 + WIN + LATENESS:
            s["purged"] = True
            emit(w2, k2, "PURGE", eid, wm, s["val"], 0, "state released (end + 1min)")

print("WATERMARK TIMELINE (bound = 30s)")
print(f"{'ev':>5} {'key':>4} {'event_time':>11} {'watermark':>10}")
for eid, key, et, wm in wm_log:
    print(f"{eid:>5} {key:>4} {et:>11} {wm:>10}")

print("\nPANE LOG")
print(pd.DataFrame(panes)[["seq","window","key","pane","trigger","watermark","cum_value","delta","note"]]
        .to_string(index=False))

final = pd.DataFrame(panes)
final = final[final.pane.isin(["ON_TIME","LATE"])]
print("\nMATERIALIZED OUTPUT (materialized/accumulating view)")
print(final.groupby(["window","key"]).agg(last_pane=("pane","last"),
                                          panes=("seq","count"),
                                          value=("cum_value","last")).reset_index().to_string(index=False))

print("\nPANE-TYPE COUNTS:", dict(pd.DataFrame(panes).pane.value_counts()))
